parameters.content:
## New Content Broadcast
When a new repository appears in your GitHub feed, Gemini drafts a 50 to 60 word email for subscribers interested in that topic. The draft waits in the Queue tab and only sends after you tick Approved.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: 'Write in plain, professional English for B2B readers. Title Case for headings and subjects. Lead with the reader problem. No em dashes, semicolons, exclamation marks, emojis or hype words. Do not start sentences with This, These or That. Never invent numbers, quotes or results. Write a 50 to 60 word email telling launch-course subscribers about this new piece, opening with one pain-point hook sentence. Return JSON {subject (Title Case), body}. Piece: ' + $json.url }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.3, responseMimeType: 'application/json' } }) }}

parameters.jsCode:
return $input.all().map((i, n) => { const o = JSON.parse(i.json.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text), src = $('Detect New Repository').all()[n].json;
  return { json: { ID: 'q' + Date.now() + n, Created: new Date().toISOString(), Workflow: 'New content broadcast', Kind: 'broadcast', Target: JSON.stringify({ url: src.url, topic: 'none' }), Subject: o.subject, Draft: o.body, Status: 'awaiting approval', Approved: false } }; });
